text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: During the concert, Umamusume praise each other's efforts in the race through song and dance.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But did you know that different types of dances use different muscles?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In that case, you understand then, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The concert venue is the perfect place for conducting an observation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The muscles used to form different facial expressions in various dances! The rise in body temperature, the increased pulse—the accelerated heartbeat!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But the thing is, you can't properly observe these when you're also dancing on stage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's why I want you to film the performance. I can see no other alternative.
choice_data_list: How about increasing your perceptive skills?
How about increasing your dynamic visual acuity?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Though it seems a bit nerve-racking, being able to collect large amounts of data with minimal input sounds quite appealing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: First, I need to build up the stamina needed to reduce the strain encumbered while observing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that we have that settled… Trainer! It's your time to mime!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I will try to guess what you are acting out while I dance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wind up performing pantomime after pantomime to assist with Agnes Tachyon's dance lesson…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: There is dynamic visual acuity and kinetic visual acuity… So essentially, I'll be increasing my visual functionality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… Intriguing! I feel a surge of desire to conduct research, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's give it a try! Come on, Trainer, get on stage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's see if my eyes can capture your every movement, from the emotion in your gaze to the twirling of your hair strands!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: One day, I shall be capable of observing even the speed of light!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to improve Agnes Tachyon's dynamic visual acuity, I begin dancing alone on stage.
